Contoso unveils the Contoso Fold 2
CONTOSO CITY, October 7, 2026 — Contoso today announced the Contoso Fold 2, a folding phone with a larger inner screen, a hinge rated for a million folds and two days of battery life.
The Fold 2 will be available to order from October 14, starting at $1,299, in three colours. Shipping begins October 21 in the United States.
“We rebuilt the hinge from the ground up,” said a Contoso vice president of devices, in a statement released with the announcement this morning.
